successors.name: Sultanate of Sambaliung
successors.text: Cliopatria's Sambaliung outline of 1830 (51 cells, 117.26-118.87E, 0.86-2.43N), which covers the Berau coast down to the Mangkalihat peninsula

successors.name: Sultanate of Gunung Tabur
successors.text: Tanjung Redeb and the lower Berau river, where the seat at Sungai Lati lay

wars.name: Berau civil war
wars.outcome: 'Berau later fell under a civil war in 1770'; it ended with the Sulu sack of 1789.

wars.name: Sulu sack of Berau and Tarakan
wars.outcome: Sulu sacked Berau and Tarakan; Bulungan declared independence from Berau.

certainty.note: Both pages give no boundary; the sultanate is a coastal strip and river basins in forest, with Bulungan, Kutai and Tidung lands beside it.
